tools.description: Follow correlation paths from start objects to specific goal classes. Returns a graph of correlated classes with queries and result counts. Use for targeted queries like "find logs for this pod" or "what alerts fired for this deployment?" Start queries use "domain:class:selector" format; goals are class names like ["log:application"]. See 'help' for syntax.
